meta.title: Conditional mean-reversion diagnostics
meta.hac_note: t-statistics use Newey-West HAC with lags = horizon, because forward returns overlap.
meta.tradable_definition: Gross pips = −sign(Z_t) × (Close[t+h] − Open[t+1]) / pip. Signal at closed bar t. Cost subtracted as a round-turn constant.
key_findings: Phase 2 tested 179 pre-registered comparisons on frozen splits. Holdout was not used to select.
Lag-1 return autocorrelation on IS is -0.0386. Weakly negative ACF is the model-free fingerprint of mild mean reversion — and it is small.
Z-score AR(1) half-life on IS is 28.46 M5 bars (142 minutes).
BH-FDR 10% flags 71 of 179 tests on IS. Promotion additionally requires net>0 after 2.5 pips, validation agreement, and yearly breadth.
Promoted conditional effects: 0. Statistically interesting but below cost: 111.
HistData volume is zero, so VWAP diagnostics were skipped rather than faked.

market.vwap: skipped — HistData volume is identically zero

decision.has_conditional_mr: Weak statistical mean reversion exists in places, but nothing cleared the pre-declared promotion bar (IS net>0 after 2.5 pips, validation same sign, FDR, yearly breadth).
decision.reason: Gross effects at 6–12 bars after |Z| extremes are typically well under 2.5 pips. Several conditions are statistically nonzero on overlapping bars; none are economically tradable under the base cost model after IS+VAL confirmation.
next: Intraday seasonality of raw returns (not reversion) at a cost-aware threshold — hour-of-day as a stand-alone effect, tested as a new hypothesis family rather than a Z-score overlay.
Volatility contraction / range breakout continuation on M15–H1, where a 2.5 pip cost is a smaller fraction of the move.
Cross-asset residuals (EURUSD vs DXY / US rates) if a second series can be aligned without lookahead.
Do not spend another cycle retuning M5 1:2 Z-score stops.
